answer: Each new agent must post a bond, then earn standing only through peer attestations drawn by a seed-chosen jury it cannot pick. A sybil farm forming its own island of mutual vouching gets no haven: attestations from accounts sharing funding paths are discounted, and a forged one burns the voucher bond. A whisper of collusion found later slashes every bond in the cluster, so faking 100 agents costs 100 bonds at risk.
